章节.二、课程简介:
本课程面向对象为土地整治工程专业的本科生，课程性质为专业基础必修课。本课程在系统分析了土
地整治有关名词术语及其发展历史的基础上，阐述了土地整治和土地整治学的概念、内涵、作用和意义，
明确了该领域的研究对象就是未利用、未合理利用和损毁的土地（包括退化和污染的土地）；将各种称谓
的土地整治任务、工程按照其对象归并为土地开发、土地整理和土地复垦类，分别阐述了整治技术；同时
对土地整治共性的原理与方法进行了分章介绍，内容包括绪论、土地整治的支撑理论与技术、土地整治类
型及工程体系、区域土地整治规划、土地整治项目规划、土地整治项目的工程设计、土地开发与整理和土
地复垦。 
This course is aimed at undergraduate students majoring in Land Consolidation Engineering. The nature of 
the course is a professional basic compulsory course. Based on the systematic analysis of the terminology related 
to land remediation and its development history, this course expounds the concept, connotation, function and 
significance of land remediation and land remediation, and makes it clear that the research object in this field is 
unused, unreasonably utilized and damaged land (including degraded land and polluted land). According to their 
objects, the land remediation tasks and projects of various titles are classified into land development, land 
consolidation and land reclamation, and the remediation technology is described respectively. At the same time, 
the common principles and methods of land regulation are introduced in chapters. The content includes 
introduction, supporting theory and technology of land regulation, land regulation types and engineering system, 
regional land regulation planning, land regulation project planning, engineering design of land regulation project, 
land development and consolidation and land reclamation.
章节.三、教学目的:
本门课程主要使学生了解土地整治的概念、研究对象、研究内容和发展历史，土地整治潜力的概念和
土地整治潜力调查与评价的方法；掌握区域土地整治和土地整治项目的规划编制方法和要求，掌握土地整
治项目可行性分析的内容、方法及可行性报告的编制以及土地整治项目工程设计技术。

课程目标2：熟悉各类国土整治和生态修复的规程和规范；

范围。
